important_constraints: Catalogue has 3,266 approved entries; avoid copying a four-city fixed selector into production Kundali.
Individual record must carry all six approval fields, valid IANA timezone and exact curated coordinates; no name-only guessing.
Some global latitudes exceed WSS03 currently supported ±65°. Keep birthplace search available, but withhold Lagna in those geographic cases.
Do not transmit birth date, time or name when fetching approved location catalogue.
Place record coordinates are locality/city reference points; user must be able to review or correct precision before asserting exact household birth coordinates.
Historical timezone rules still use platform tzdb, not reproducibly pinned and audited for all locations.
Existing public location loader uses Supabase `action:locations` then five-record static fallback; WSS07 must never treat the fallback as a complete 3,266-place production catalogue.
No public Kundali is released until all WSS08 accuracy, consent, security and browser gates pass.
